summary: Trinity crashes through a window with an explosion of glass and wood and falls onto a back stairwell, tumbling and bouncing down the stairs bleeding and broken but still alive. She wheels on the smashed opening above with her gun instantly in hand, trained and waiting for Agent Brown, but is met only by a slight wind hissing against the broken glass. Everything hurts. She tells herself to get up, insisting she is fine, then stands and limps down the rest of the stairs.

what_changes.before: Reeling from the crash, broken and bleeding at the bottom of the fall
what_changes.after: On her feet and moving again despite the pain
what_changes.evidence: She stands and limps down the rest of the stairs.

what_changes.before: Expecting Agent Brown to come through the opening after her
what_changes.after: Finding only wind, no pursuer present
what_changes.evidence: her gun instantly in her hand, trained, waiting for Agent Brown but is met by only a slight WIND

event_hint.one_line: Trinity survives the window crash and regains her footing, expecting Agent Brown to follow but finding no one.

uncertain: Whether Agent Brown is still in pursuit or has broken off.
How badly Trinity is actually injured.
